teaser.en: The 'small mtsani' has fern-like leaves and a flat crown, and carpenters still count it among their timbers.
teaser.sw: 'Mtsani mdogo' una majani kama ya kangaga na kilele bapa, na maseremala bado huuhesabu miongoni mwa mbao zao.
teaser.dg: *Mtsani* mdide una makodza dza ga *fern* na dari sawa-sawa, na mafundi a mbao hata sambi anauolanga kahi ya mihi yao ya mbao.

summary.en: *Mtsani tsiye*, the flat-crown albizia, is a flat-topped tree of coastal forest edges with fern-like leaves and white-green powder-puff flowers. It belongs to the *mtsani* group of trees used by carpenters.
summary.sw: *Mtsani tsiye*, au *mchani*, ni mti wenye kilele bapa wa pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani wenye majani kama ya kangaga na maua meupe-kijani yanayofanana na vifuta-poda. Ni wa kundi la miti ya *mtsani* inayotumiwa na maseremala.
summary.dg: *Mtsani tsiye* (kpwa Chingereza *flat-crown albizia*) ni muhi wenye dari sawa-sawa wa kanda za matsaka ga pwani, wenye makodza dza ga *fern* na maruwa mereru genye chijani chidide, dza mafungu ga nyuzi. Ni kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani* inayohumirwa ni mafundi a mbao.

about.en: *Mtsani tsiye* has a wide, flat top, often spreading above the trees around it. Its leaves are twice divided into many small leaflets, so they look like fern fronds. The bark is pale grey, and the flowers are white-green powder-puffs.
about.sw: *Mtsani tsiye* una kilele kipana na bapa, ambacho mara nyingi hutanda juu ya miti inayouzunguka. Majani yake yamegawanyika mara mbili katika vijani vingi vidogo, hivyo yanafanana na majani ya kangaga. Gome ni la kijivu hafifu, na maua ni meupe-kijani yanayofanana na vifuta-poda.
about.dg: *Mtsani tsiye* una dari pana sawa-sawa, ambayo mara nyinji inatandazika dzulu ya mihi inayouzunguluka. Makodzage ganaganywa mara mbiri, kuhenda makodza madide manji, kpwa hivyo ganaonekana dza makodza ga *fern*. Gopha ni ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu, na maruwa ni mafungu ga nyuzi mereru genye chijani chidide.

where.en: It grows at coastal forest edges and in secondary forest. The flat crown makes it easy to pick out on a forest margin.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani na katika misitu ya pili. Kilele chake bapa huufanya mti huu uwe rahisi kuutambua pembezoni mwa msitu.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka ga pwani na kpwenye matsaka garigomera tsena. Dariye sawa-sawa inahenda ukale rahisi kuuona kanda ya tsaka.

uses.en: It is one of the *mtsani* group of trees used for timber by carpenters.
uses.sw: Ni mmojawapo wa kundi la miti ya *mtsani* inayotumiwa na maseremala kwa mbao.
uses.dg: Ni kahi ya mihi ya *mtsani* inayohumirwa ni mafundi a mbao kuhenda mbao.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsani tsiye*, 'small *mtsani*', as against *mtsani ndzovu*, the large one. In Swahili it is *mchani*. In English it is the flat-crown albizia.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsani tsiye*, yaani '*mtsani* mdogo', tofauti na *mtsani ndzovu*, aina kubwa. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mchani*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *flat-crown albizia*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mtsani tsiye*, '*mtsani* mdide', tafwauti na *mtsani ndzovu*, ambao ni mkulu. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchani*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *flat-crown albizia*.

reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa msituni wenye majani kama manyoya
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa tsakani wenye makodza madide manji dza manyoya

mgombato: mtsani (mi) type of plant (Albizia versicolor); mkarati, mtututu, mkarakala, mhina mwitu, mwiza, mnembenembe.
sources: Pakia, M. (2005) African Traditional Plant Knowledge Today: an ethnobotanical study of the Digo at the Kenya Coast. PhD thesis, Univ. Bayreuth, Appendix III (Digo–botanical name list) & Appendix VI (name semantics). https://epub.uni-bayreuth.de/881/1/Pakia.pdf
